story.festival_midsummer.name: Midsummer
story.festival_midsummer.desc: A midsummer challenge: build three campfires.
story.festival_midsummer.ch.c1.sum: Midsummer is bonfire time. Build three campfires.
story.festival_midsummer.r1.start: Midsummer! The longest day of the year, and everywhere people light fires at dusk. Build three campfires and I have torches for the night.
story.festival_midsummer.graduated: Fire and light for the shortest night. Torches and lanterns for you.
story.festival_midsummer.d1.done: Three fires burning. The night is short and warm.
